Check Hana's diary for that weekend

situation: Planning a surprise party for a friend.

text:
Ok so I have a venue idea the back room at the bar on Ghuznee St, they do private hire, fits about 40 standing
[link: Ghuznee St bar, private hire page]
Oooh that's the one with the good pizza?
Yes!! And it's close to the car park so people can get home easy
Sounds decent. Is it bookable on a saturday
No idea yet, I'll ring tmrw at lunch
Sorry was on a call with a guy whose laptop hasn't turned on since March. Yeah the back room is fine I think, been there for Ash's thing
Does anyone know if she's free the 16th or is that her work weekend
I'll see if I can find out without it being obvious. Her sister's easy to get info out of
Ruby if you can do that without her knowing it'd be amazing
Up a ladder in someone's ceiling in Kilbirnie till late, will read the chat later
Go electrocute yourself responsibly
Ha. No
Ok she's free the 16th. Her sister says she's been wanting something low key at a pub but told everyone not to make a fuss
(or is that her testing me lol)
"low key pub" is literally what we're doing perfect
16th of Jan that's a Saturday right
Yes Kieran
Just checking, the router reset itself again so my whole brain has been lagging
Ok can someone help with the guest list? I've got like 14 names from school people who knew her from netball and I don't want to flood the room
Lol yes. Send me what you have and I'll go through it against the people she mentioned from book club
Sorry just got in. The pizza place, does the room have a sound system or are we bringing one
No idea, I'll ask when I ring. Probably not
Ok I'll bring a speaker, my flatmate has a big one he never uses
Who's doing food. I can do the sausage rolls again if nobody else has them
Please yes. Cake I think is me or Emily, we can decide tmrw
I'll do the cake, I've got my mum's tin
Morning. Laptop guy finally got it going, now he wants help with his printer
Printers are cursed
Don't I know it
Rang the bar. The 16th is free!! They need a $300 deposit to hold it, min spend is $1000 on food and drink. Room has no sound system so Tane you're needed
They'll do a cake table and put the pizza out at 7 if we pre order
I'm paying the deposit tonight unless someone says no
Fine by me. Speaker's coming, flatmate says I can borrow it if I bring it back in one piece
Deposit's fine. Want me to chip in or split it with you Em
Split is fine, I'll send you the account thing tonight
Guest list done. Dropped 4 from the netball lot, they're mostly from her work, not really her people. Left the rest
That's 31 names including us
[file: guest list.xlsx]
She's going to ask who's coming and I'll have to lie to her face
31 is good for 40. Sausage rolls for 31 is maybe 80? Does that sound mad
80 is fine. Everyone eats them
Are we sure she's not on shift that weekend? She said something about covering for someone in Jan
She's free. Her sister confirmed. Ruby stop asking things it's making me nervous
Lol ok
[photo: mum's tin, looks like it's been through a war]
It's fine. It's a good tin
Got the ceiling done. Guy in Kilbirnie tried to pay me in a sourdough starter
Took it
Are you going to bake with it
No idea how
Deposit paid. [photo: bank confirmation]
Ruby I've sent your half
Got it. Thanks Em
Anyone know if the pizza place does gluten free or do I need to ask
Ask. I'll put it on the pre order sheet though
Speaker's charged. Flatmate says it's a loan, not a gift
Went past the bar this morning to look at the room. I think 40 standing is a stretch
[photo: back room with the chairs stacked against the wall]
Ok that's a squeeze but it's fine for a Sat night. Everyone won't be there at once
Rather 31 people than 40 I reckon
Rang the bar about gf. Bloke said "we can do a base." Not sure if that's a yes
Asked if the sausage rolls can be gf and he laughed at me
Put "gf base" on the sheet for now, we can check closer to the date
Hana just texted me asking if I'm free the 16th. Sounded casual. Said yes and didn't say anything else
Feel like she's onto me
She's not onto you. The 16th is a Saturday, people ask
She also asked what I'm doing tonight
I said nothing. She said "suspicious"
Ruby just be normal. Normal is what you do
That's the problem. I'm not normal when I'm lying
Cake update: going with the lemon one. Anyone allergic to anything?
Nuts maybe? Not me, just checking
Got a job in Miramar first thing tomorrow so I'm out of action till lunch
[photo: first attempt at the lemon cake, the middle has sunk]
It's fine. It's a sunk cake, still a cake
Eat the middle bit then
Hana's sister just rang me to ask about the 16th, very politely, for about twenty minutes. Said nothing useful
I think she's gathering intel for Hana
Ruby. Stop
Lol ok ok
